_catatan: Naskah explainer d-day, diturunkan dari content/buklet.js (disetujui Farrez 9 Nov 2026).

gaya.id: Bacakan sebagai narator film dokumenter yang tenang, hangat, dan yakin, seperti video explainer sejarah. Tempo sedang, beri jeda panjang di antara paragraf.
gaya.en: Read as a calm, warm, confident documentary narrator, like a history explainer video. Medium pace, with a long pause between paragraphs.

teks.id: Seorang teman punya strategi trading kripto dan ingin lepas dari bot pihak ketiga yang ia pakai.
teks.en: A friend had a crypto trading strategy and wanted to move off the third-party bot they were using.

teks.id: Pemilik strategi paham trading tapi tidak membaca kode. Ia perlu mengubah parameter dan membaca hasilnya sendiri.
teks.en: The strategy owner knows trading but doesn't read code. They need to change settings and read results on their own.

teks.id: Stop loss dipasang sebagai order di exchange, bukan sekadar dicek oleh bot.
teks.en: Stop losses are placed as orders on the exchange, not just watched by the bot.

teks.id: Untung kotor, slippage, fee, dan PPh 1% per penjualan dipisah, jadi angkanya bisa dipercaya.
teks.en: Gross profit, slippage, fees and the 1% sales tax are separated, so the numbers can be trusted.

teks.id: Lulus gerbang uji di testnet pada 7 Oktober 2026 dengan strategi uji. Belum pernah memakai uang sungguhan.
teks.en: Passed the test gate on testnet on 7 October 2026 with a test strategy. No real money has been used.
